violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device in the self service open display cooler: containers of individually sliced cheese cakes (45-46 F) and peach cream cakes (46 F). Additionally, observed caprese sandwiches at 45 F in the self service display cooler (12).
violations.corrective_action: All foods were voluntarily discarded. EHS advised operator to leave 1 item for display and leave signage for customers to order at the register until the unit is repaired. PIC will send confirmation of signage by sending a picture to EHS’s email.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: various TCS pastries to be discarded at 5pm.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC UPDATED THE TIMES ON THE TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH RECORDS DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed boxed avocados and mangoes in the kitchen and boxed foods in walk in freezer stored directly on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: PIC relocated boxed foods. EHS re-educated.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The self service display cooler (11) is in poor repair. The temperature of the unit read 44 degrees F.
violations.corrective_action: PIC already had requested service and is currently awaiting a part for the equipment. PIC will follow up with EHS when equipment is serviced and fixed. Do not store TCS foods in the equipment until it is repaired and can hold proper cold holding temperatures of at 41 F or below.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MILK AT 44-46F IN CARAFES ON SELF SERVICE COFFEE STATION; GARLIC BUTTER AT 66F UNDER COUNTER NEAR SANDWICH STATION; CAPRESE SANDWICH (SLICED TOMATOES) AT 44F IN SELF SERVICE DISPLAY.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. MILK AND GARLIC BUTTER TRANSFERRED TO REFRIGERATOR FOR RAPID COOLING; CAPRESE DISCARDED DURING INSPECTION. EHS RECOMMENDED THAT TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL PROCEDURES BE USED FOR MILK IN CARAFES. MILK MUST HAVE A START TEMPERATURE OF 41F OR BELOW AND DISCARDED AFTER 4 HOURS.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide ACCURATE written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): OBSERVED DOCUMENTED START TIME FOR FOODS WERE NOT UPDATED WHEN FOODS WERE REPLACED; OVEN TEMPERATURES WERE DOCUMENTED INSTEAD OF ACTUAL FOOD TEMPERATURES; NEW MENU ITEMS WERE NOT ADDED TO TPHC DOCUMENTATION CHART SUCH AS FOLIAGE SAUSAGE BREAD, OLIVE & TOMATO BREAD, JALAPEÑO HAM CROISSANT, PORTUGUESE EGG TART, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE TPHC PROCEDURES ARE UPDATED AND DOCUMENTED ACCURATELY. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counters in: FRONT SERVICE AND BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items: SEVERAL BOTTLES OF PAPRIKA STORED ON SHELVING WITH CLEANING CHEMICALS ABOVE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED PAPRIKA DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed FIRST AID ITEMS stored in such a way that they could contaminate CARTOONS OF DECORATIVE SUGAR AND GLAZE ON CART TO END OF PREP TABLE IN MAIN KITCHEN AREA.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO STORE FOOD ITEMS SEPARATELY FROM FIRST AID ITEMS AND RELOCATE TO UNDER PREP TABLE.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counters in: MAIN KITCHEN PREP TABLE, HANGING ON HANDWASH SINK IN MAIN KITCHEN, PREP TABLE IN CAKE ROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE SANITIZER SOLUTIONS OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATIONS ARE PREPARED TO STORE WET WIPING CLOTHS. CHANGE SOLUTIONS AT LEAST EVERY 4 HOURS OR AS REQUIRED.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Materials Smooth, Durable, Cleanable
violations.observation: The UNFINISHED WOODEN PLANKS located at SIDE OF MAIN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR the does not meet the standard of: 1. smooth, durable and easily cleanable.
violations.corrective_action: Wall, floor, and ceiling surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, warewashing areas, and toilet rooms. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE WOODEN SURFACES ARE FINISHED WITH PAINT OR OTHER SUITABLE FINISHING.
